structure: Use one positively dependent rank-copula law, anchored to the reported within-sex Pearson correlation. Preserve both supplied marginal columns exactly. Enforce the physiological inequality through a specified deterministic repair rather than deleting rows or changing volumes. The transported correlation and copula shape are explicit modeling assumptions; broader target morbidity alone does not identify a replacement dependence parameter.
parameter_provenance: Female and male arithmetic moments come from supplied Table 1 excerpts and determine the nominal lognormal calibration.
The Pearson reference of 0.96 for each sex comes from supplied Table 2 excerpts.
Gaussian copula shape and the nearest-index feasibility repair are author choices, not reported source findings.
Regression slopes, intercepts and R2 are not additional independent constraints and are not imposed as individual identities.
Source sample sizes do not determine population sex weights or generator block sizes.
requested_estimands: Mean individual FEV1/FVC: compute the mean paired ratio within each sex, then average the two sex means with equal weights.

Ratio of population means: divide the equally sex-weighted FEV1 mean by the equally sex-weighted FVC mean. Pairing cannot change this estimand. At the displayed source means it is 5.8/7.6, approximately 0.7632.
Fraction strictly below 0.70: compute mean(FEV1/FVC < 0.70) separately by sex, then average with equal weights; do not use <=.

Within-sex volume correlation: report Pearson correlation separately for F and M when both volumes have nonzero variance. The achieved correlations need not equal 0.96 after finite-grid ranking and feasibility repair.
limitations: Healthy never-smokers from community screening are not representative of all adults with smoking exposure or respiratory illness. The target dependence and low-ratio fraction are not identified by the supplied evidence.
The source spans ages 18–85, whereas the requested population spans 18–79. No individual age or stature information permits reweighting or adjustment.
No bronchodilator intervention is described, but the excerpts do not independently establish a detailed pre-bronchodilator protocol.
Ideal-lognormal calibration is approximate for affinely standardized finite grids. Feasibility repair can alter correlation, ratio dispersion and the low-ratio fraction.
The source provides no residual or ratio distribution. A Gaussian copula does not establish the correct dependence in clinically important tails.
Repeated seeds assess generator variability only, not transport uncertainty or uncertainty in source parameters.
checks_actually_performed: Analytical check: 0.96 times the displayed SD ratio gives an FEV1-on-FVC slope of 0.84 for females and 0.80 for males. Thus the displayed male moments and slope cannot all be imposed exactly, consistent with the supplied rounding caveat.
Analytical check: pairing leaves both marginal means and therefore the ratio of population means unchanged.
No generator execution, supplied-array inspection or target validation was possible. The executable includes input, permutation and physiological-feasibility checks.
